text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The end of the year has come, and with it, the Arima Kinen—the final determiner of the year's best racer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet heads towards the fateful race, vowing to seize the number one spot regardless of whatever may come her way.
